stem: How is the section "An Unusual Design" organized in order to develop the thesis of the article?

options.label: A
options.text: The steps that the native peoples used are included to explain how snow goggles were created.

options.label: B
options.text: Problems with snow goggles are described to show how solutions were created over time.

options.label: C
options.text: The qualities of snow goggles are listed in the order of their importance.

options.label: D
options.text: Similarities and differences are used to compare snow goggles with modern sunglasses.
